newsitem.title: USA: Pan Am posts Q1 loss of $14.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pan Am posts Q1 loss of $14.6 mln.

text.p: Pan Am Corp said on Thursday it reported a net loss of $14.6 million, or $1.33 a share, in the first quarter of 1997 on revenues of $21.7 million.
Pan Am recorded a non-operating income of $238,000 in the first quarter.
Comparable figures for 1996 are not meaningful as the corporation was in a pre-start period.
Pan Am currently operates a fleet of four A-300's and wet-leases three 727's, the company said.
A fifth and sixth A-300 will be placed into scheduled service by Pan Am by July 1, the company said.

The wet-leasing of aircraft resulted in higher operating costs to Pan Am. Although Pan Am will continue to wet-lease some 727's, the company said it is currently in active negotiations to reduce the rental rates on those aircraft.
